title: Count with repeat times
objective: Run lines a fixed number of times, and read the counter that repeat times using gives you.

body.text: repeat N times using i runs the indented lines N times. The name after using is a counter that you choose. It starts at 0, so the lines see 0, then 1, and so on up to N minus 1. A loop of 5 times therefore shows the numbers 0 to 4.

body.title: Count five times
body.code:
repeat 5 times using i
    say i

body.text: The counter has a name you choose, so you can use it in text. The loop still runs only the number of times you wrote, whatever name you give the counter.

body.prompt: The game only takes two turns, but it should take three. Make it print turn 0, turn 1 and turn 2.

checks.description: It prints turn 0, turn 1 and turn 2
